releaseNotes: Teacher app 1.13.9: fixes the app installing but NOT OPENING on teachers' phones. Every APK up to 1.13.8 was accidentally built as a debug build - 78MB of debug code that Android kills at startup on low-memory phones. 1.13.9 is a true release build (2.8MB, fast on any phone), signed with the same key as 1.13.8 so it installs as a normal update over 1.13.8. Phones still on an older version (1.13.7 or below): uninstall the old app ONCE (open it first and use Cloud Sync if it still opens, so nothing is lost), then install this APK. Console 2.2.24 unchanged.
